build_ResidualBlock: build a ResidualBlock with configurable input planes, output planes, normalization function, and stride for feature extraction
build_BasicEncoder: build a BasicEncoder with configurable output dimension, normalization function, and dropout rate for image feature encoding
run_ResidualBlock_forward: run the ResidualBlock forward pass on a tensor to compute residual features with convolutions and normalization
run_BasicEncoder_forward: run the BasicEncoder forward pass on an image tensor or list of tensors to extract features
review_BasicEncoder_make_layer: review the BasicEncoder _make_layer method that constructs sequential ResidualBlock layers with configurable dimensions and stride
